source: Authored manufactured and synthetic controls for the MC-03 melt-segregation closure selection. All material values are synthetic and labelled as such; the phase densities repeat the illustration values of Spiegelman (1993) Table 1 without adopting them. At the uniform 1% liquid volume fraction, k = K/mu = 1e-13 m2/(Pa s) and zeta + 4 eta/3 = 1e19 Pa s give a 1000 m compaction length, so the 32/64/128-cell grids on the 4 km column resolve h/delta = 1/8, 1/16 and 1/32. The melting rate 1e-9 kg m-3 s-1 gives a reaction-volume source Gamma (1/rho_f - 1/rho_s) of about 5.4e-14 per second, comparable in effect to the buoyancy-driven flux of about 4.9e-10 m/s. The manufactured state varies the liquid volume fraction by 20% with a cosine overpressure that vanishes at the rigid top. The balance state has a graded grid, a dry base, a disconnected wet segment, melting and freezing and a free-flux top. No observed region, provider state, calibration or planetary default.
